notes: v1.14.576 — THE DUPLICATE TEN-TOOL PATH LEAVES THE PHONE. FIRST-DOOR Ship A slice A-3, rows 7 and 8. That removes it at EVERY width and strips desktop tool access at >=1024, which the owner ruling of 2026-09-01 forbids in terms: .559 measured the cost and the ruling reads "the phone loses the duplicate, the desktop keeps its door. It is a re-home, not a close." Row 8 says "deleted - no home ON THE FIRST SCREEN", and the first screen is the phone, so the close is a COMPOSITION close and belongs in CSS, not in markup. ⭐ THE LESSON IS THE ONE A-2a ALREADY WROTE DOWN AND I STILL WALKED INTO: DELETION IS MARKUP, SO IT APPLIES AT EVERY WIDTH, while the surface a ship is scoped to is ONE COMPOSITION. Writing a rule down does not make it operative; checking against it does. It held Universal Scan and Shift handoff. SCAN stays reachable on the phone through Build action list (:22377); HANDOFF stays reachable through the Open handoff button inside #cs-ready (:13931), which is row 9 and is KEPT. A full-span card in a two-column grid is not a hole, so the template is LEFT ALONE rather than tidied. NOT IN THIS SHIP: A-4, the readiness indeterminate gate (row 9), the last Ship A slice.
